title: PDV Phase 19 approved Temple location rules
notes: First approved live-content packet for the Phase 19 generated classification patch.
Adds the existing vanilla LocTypeTemple keyword to obvious shrine/temple LCTN records that currently lack it.
This is core vanilla/DLC classification content eligible for later main-ESP promotion, but Phase 19 keeps it in the generated review artifact.
